build.notes: Out-of-tree build in obj-gcov. make runs the lib and bc targets with one job (the build is not parallel-safe) and MAKEINFO=true to skip the manual. GCC records the generated scanner and parser sources (bc.c, bc.y, scan.c, scan.l) under obj-gcov/bc, where they do not exist; build.stage_sources lists the copies that put them there, which the builder makes after the build and the runner repeats, so that the initial lcov capture prints no warning.
